Every gate combination is also pinned by a MockHarness test recording the actual (type, op) pairs perm_fn was called with, not an assumed pair.

trigger: route-registration ORDER changed for all 13 non-mcp_disabled routes -- five modules moved from their original ~14300-15800 line positions in server.cpp to the shared inline_sink block at ~13580, ahead of the still-inline routes (health/readiness/metrics/response/tags/inventory) and every other still-remaining route
summary: httplib::Server matches routes by first-match-wins over EXACT strings or std::regex_match (full-string, never partial) in registration order. Checked every route pattern registered by every extracted module ahead of this PR's new insertion point (page_routes, dashboard_api_routes, nvd_routes, custom_properties_routes, result_set_routes) for any pattern that could shadow /events, /api/config(/[a-z_]+)?, /api/chargen/*, /api/procfetch/*, /fragments/instructions(/yaml-preview)?, or /fragments/approvals -- none found (custom_properties_routes' /api/agents/([^/]+)/properties patterns require that literal prefix and cannot match /api/config). This check is scoped to patterns registered BEFORE the new insertion point -- that is the only set that can newly shadow the 13 reordered routes. The codebase's one catch-all/prefix-wildcard pattern, /api/responses/(.+) (Response API, server.cpp:14887, still inline), was NOT re-examined against this criterion: it requires the literal /api/responses/ prefix so it cannot match any of the six moved paths regardless, and it is registered AFTER the new insertion point in file order, so it could not shadow the moved routes even if it matched. Route order change is therefore behavior-neutral.

Gate 1 Resource Ledger (added retroactively per Gate 3 cpp-safety's finding that no formal ledger accompanied the diff). Three real resource-acquisition sites exist in this PR, all confined to legacy_events_routes.cpp's /events handler, all moved verbatim from origin/dev with no ownership/lifetime change: (1) StreamBudget::Lease via deps.stream_budget->try_acquire(SseSurface::kLegacyEvents) -- acquired after the deny-gate, released via the chunked-content-provider's resource-releaser closure invoked from ~httplib::Response on every exit path (normal completion or early client disconnect), confirmed by direct read of vcpkg httplib.h's content_provider_resource_releaser_ invocation; (2) EventBus::subscribe sub_id, owned by SseSinkState, unsubscribed in the same releaser closure; (3) the releaser closure itself, captured by set_chunked_content_provider and owned by httplib's Response object for its lifetime. No other module in this PR (config_routes, diagnostics_routes, instruction_fragment_routes, approvals_fragment_routes, mcp_disabled_routes) acquires a raw resource -- all hold only non-owning pointers/std::function copies bound once at start_web_server() time, matching the established #2542 Deps-struct idiom.
